extracted.name: Avocado, Tomato and Mango Salsa
extracted.description: This refreshing avocado, tomato, and mango salsa recipe with red onion, jalapeño, garlic, cilantro, and lime is served with tortilla chips or on fish.
instruction_lines: Combine tomatoes, mango, avocado, jalapeño, cilantro, and garlic in a medium bowl; stir in red onion, olive oil, lime juice, and salt. Refrigerate to blend the flavors, about 30 minutes.
